description: This file defines a Flutter widget called NoteCard that displays a note's title, content, last updated time, and an optional pinned icon. It also handles tap and long-press interactions and visual styles including color customization based on note properties.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that visually represents a note with styling and interaction capabilities.

methods.name: _resolveAccent
methods.description: Determines the accent color for the note card, either derived from note's colorHex or defaulting to the theme's primary color.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the NoteCard, including layout, styling, and interaction handlers.
